scope: Compiled method-only original/JVM faults; baseline full instruction coverage remains failed.

controls.name: initial-delay-duration
controls.reason: Initial suspension delay is exactly 5000ms.

controls.name: initial-label-before-delay
controls.reason: The continuation is label1 before the first delay boundary.

controls.name: initial-result-validation
controls.reason: Initial failure result must escape before changing state or delaying.

controls.name: label-one-result-validation
controls.reason: Label1 validates its result outside the monitor catch.

controls.name: label-three-result-validation
controls.reason: Label3 validates its result outside the monitor catch.

controls.name: retain-dead-file-cast
controls.reason: Label2 retains the otherwise unused saved File cast.

controls.name: retain-dead-flag-cast
controls.reason: Label2 retains the otherwise unused saved qnc cast.

controls.name: dead-cast-order
controls.reason: Distinct malformed source types expose File-before-qnc order.

controls.name: label-two-result-validation
controls.reason: A stopped-operation failure must enter its original error/retry path.

controls.name: label-two-catches-exception-only
controls.reason: Error from a label2 resumed result escapes.

controls.name: invalid-label-defensive-return
controls.reason: The injected returning guard follows the exact defensive null return.

controls.name: companion-read-before-recording
controls.reason: The companion getClass check occurs before reading the recording flag.

controls.name: inactive-unit-identity
controls.reason: An inactive recording returns the captured Unit identity.

controls.name: recording-parent-directory-read
controls.reason: The existing file parent must be consulted before fallback.

controls.name: movies-directory-argument
controls.reason: Fallback forwards the actual Environment movies constant.

controls.name: captured-storage-owner-read
controls.reason: A successful c call keeps its captured owner for x reads.

controls.name: captured-storage-owner-write
controls.reason: The x write uses the captured storage owner after owner-field mutation.

controls.name: storage-state-before-info-log
controls.reason: Availability state changes before the logger can observe or throw.

controls.name: strict-storage-report-threshold
controls.reason: Equality at a 100MiB reduction must not emit a fresh availability report.

controls.name: storage-report-interval
controls.reason: The report interval is 100MiB, not 1MiB.

controls.name: zero-prior-storage-reports
controls.reason: An initial zero availability value enters the reporting branch.

controls.name: strict-critical-storage-threshold
controls.reason: Exactly 128MiB is outside the critical-storage condition.

controls.name: storage-megabyte-log-units
controls.reason: Available and critical storage text uses division by 1048576.

controls.name: captured-storage-log-identifier
controls.reason: The storage log identifier belongs to the captured owner.

controls.name: missing-file-does-not-read-length
controls.reason: A missing file produces size zero without a length call.

controls.name: file-reread-after-exists
controls.reason: The file field is read again after exists returns.

controls.name: descriptor-size-sentinel
controls.reason: A non-null file descriptor without File yields the negative sentinel.

controls.name: file-size-catches-exception-only
controls.reason: An Error during File access escapes the inner Exception catch.

controls.name: file-error-fallback-zero
controls.reason: A caught File-size Exception resumes with size zero.

controls.name: zero-file-size-is-processed
controls.reason: Zero size still logs and updates the monitoring state.

controls.name: file-kilobyte-log-units
controls.reason: Current file size uses binary kilobytes.

controls.name: strict-positive-previous-size
controls.reason: The prior-size branch requires a strictly positive value.

controls.name: growth-subtraction-direction
controls.reason: Growth subtracts previous size from current size.

controls.name: equal-size-is-stalled
controls.reason: A zero growth value increments the stalled counter.

controls.name: stall-counter-wraps-as-int
controls.reason: Integer.MAX_VALUE increments with signed int wraparound.

controls.name: stall-counter-increments-once
controls.reason: Each stopped-growth check increments by exactly one.

controls.name: third-stalled-check-stops
controls.reason: The critical stalled threshold includes check three.

controls.name: stall-counter-owner-reread
controls.reason: The post-log counter comes from a fresh owner-field read.

controls.name: stall-seconds-wide-multiply
controls.reason: Counter-to-seconds multiplication remains long before arithmetic.

controls.name: growth-resets-stall-counter
controls.reason: Positive growth resets the captured counter to zero.

controls.name: growth-kilobyte-log-units
controls.reason: Growth text uses binary kilobytes too.

controls.name: final-size-owner-reread
controls.reason: The final previous-size write uses a freshly read owner.

controls.name: stop-callback-captures-owner
controls.reason: The stop callback captures the current owner.

controls.name: stop-callback-null-completion
controls.reason: The stop callback constructor has null completion.

controls.name: stop-dispatcher-identity
controls.reason: Dispatch uses at9.a after the preserved discarded dispatcher read.

controls.name: clear-saved-flag-before-suspension
controls.reason: L0 is cleared at every preserved suspension preparation.

controls.name: clear-saved-file-before-suspension
controls.reason: L1 is cleared at every preserved suspension preparation.

controls.name: stop-resume-label
controls.reason: Stop dispatch stores label2.

controls.name: repeat-delay-duration
controls.reason: Both retry-delay sites use exactly 3000ms.

controls.name: repeat-resume-label
controls.reason: Both repeated-delay sites store label3.

controls.name: delay-marker-reference-identity
controls.reason: An equals-only marker lookalike must not count as suspended.

controls.name: dispatch-marker-reference-identity
controls.reason: Stop dispatch also compares the suspension marker by identity.

controls.name: monitor-catches-exception-only
controls.reason: Error during storage monitoring escapes the outer catch.

controls.name: outer-error-logger-escapes
controls.reason: The error logger is not protected by another swallowing catch.

controls.name: exception-message-read-once
controls.reason: Each catch reads Throwable.getMessage once before concatenation.

controls.name: callback-before-stop-state-preparation
controls.reason: The callback constructor observes the old continuation state.

controls.name: critical-conditions-dispatch-stop
controls.reason: Both critical conditions set the stop flag.

controls.name: label-two-retry-always-suspends
controls.reason: A synchronous return from the retry delay after a label-two resumed Exception must enter the loop and observe false recording; only the suspension singleton suspends.
